newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Britain to insure West Bank, Gaza investments.
newsitem.headline: Britain to insure West Bank, Gaza investments.

text.p: Britain has extended political risk insurance to cover investors wishing to operate in Palestinian self-rule areas, the British Consulate-General said on Wednesday.
"Britain's Export Credits Risk Guarantee Department (ECGD) can now offer political risk insurance to British investors in the Palestinian Authority areas," the consulate said in a statement.
The statement said British Trade Minister Anthony Nelson had announced the measure at the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference currently underway in Cairo.
"The British Government aims with this move to expand opportunities for joint ventures and expand opportunities in the area," the statement said.
The Palestinian Authority operates in parts of the West Bank and Gaza Israel turned over to the PLO in 1994 and 1995 under landmark self-rule peace deals.
